---
name: Bug report
about: Report an implementation, numerical, artifact, or documentation defect
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Scope

Affected command, file, artifact, protocol, and version/hash.

## Observed Behavior

Include exact error and logs without secrets.

## Expected Behavior

State the documented contract or gate expectation.

## Reproduction

List environment, inputs, command, and minimal steps.

## Scientific/Claim Impact

State whether existing results, gates, manuscript claims, or releases may be
stale or invalid.

## Containment

State whether execution or release should stop pending review.
